blocks.text: FRANKFURT, Germany — Masked rioters looted shops in the German city of Frankfurt on Saturday as massive demonstrations turned violent across the country, with police firing water cannons at youths throwing Molotov cocktails. Several police officers were injured in the violence after tens of thousands of people joined youth-led protests across the country organized by the group “GenZ regelt!” (Gen Z has got this!). The demonstrations, inspired by similar movements in France and Italy calling on political elites to heed the concerns of younger generations, were largely peaceful during the day.
